title: Strict-system projection formula composition coherence
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$ of characteristic $p$ and its algebraic closure $k$
[def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension
$E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer
$\varpi_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Put
$A_n=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ for $n\geq1$. Let $X,Y,Z$ be separated
finite-type $k$-schemes and let $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y\to Z$ be separated
finite-type $k$-morphisms [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties].
For $W=X,Y,Z$ put $B_{n,W}=(A_n)_W$ on the small pro-etale site
[def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and $R_W=\lim_n B_{n,W}$
[def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Let $\mathscr S_W$ be the
abelian category of strict semilinear systems of $B_{n,W}$-module sheaves:
its objects have $B_{n+1,W}$-linear transitions
$M_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}_{B_{n+1,W}\to B_{n,W}}M_n$, and its
morphisms are componentwise module maps commuting with transitions
[lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. In $D(\mathscr S_W)$ let
$\mathscr N_W$ be the full subcategory of normalized systems, meaning
that every transition-adjoint map
$M_m\otimes^L_{B_{m,W}}B_{n,W}\to M_n$ is an isomorphism for $m\ge n$,
whose levels lie in $D^b_{ctf}(W,A_n)$, the bounded constructible
finite-Tor category [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower,
def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude].

Use the simultaneous geometric section models of pullback, derived tensor,
open extension, proper direct image and their adjunction maps from
[lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. For $h=f,g,gf$, let
$\mathcal F_h$ be the specified strict-system compact-support realization
of [lem-coef-finite-adjunction-diagram-realization], and let
$\alpha_{g,f}:\mathcal F_g\mathcal F_f\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal F_{gf}$
be the geometric compact-support composition comparison of
[thm-sf-comp-composition], formed in these same simultaneous models.
For $h:U\to V$, $P\in\mathscr N_U$, $Q\in\mathscr N_V$, write
$$
\operatorname{PF}^{\mathrm{sys}}_{h,P,Q}:
\mathcal F_hP\otimes^L Q\longrightarrow
\mathcal F_h(P\otimes^L h^*Q)
$$
for the strict-system realization of the specified projection transformation
[def-exchange-projection]: the proper direct-image counit-defined projection
mate followed by the open-extension tensor comparison in a compactification.
All these maps use the quotient transitions of the same models; they are
not independently chosen lifts of their finite evaluations.

These projection maps are natural in $P,Q$ and satisfy, for
$M\in\mathscr N_X$ and $N\in\mathscr N_Z$, the identity
$$
\alpha_{g,f,M\otimes^L f^*g^*N}\,
\mathcal F_g\!\left(\operatorname{PF}^{\mathrm{sys}}_{f,M,g^*N}\right)\,
\operatorname{PF}^{\mathrm{sys}}_{g,\mathcal F_fM,N}
=
\operatorname{PF}^{\mathrm{sys}}_{gf,M,N}\,
(\alpha_{g,f,M}\otimes1_N).
$$
Both sides have source $\mathcal F_g\mathcal F_fM\otimes^L N$ and target
$\mathcal F_{gf}(M\otimes^L(gf)^*N)$, using the canonical pullback,
tensor and associator identifications. This is an equality in
$D(\mathscr S_Z)$ before total derived inverse limit. Its level-$n$
evaluations are the specified finite projection identities. The functor
$\mathcal L_Z=R\lim\circ U_Z$ of
[lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], with $U_Z$ termwise
restriction to $R_Z$-module towers, carries this equality to the equality
of its total-limit images.

source.place: Proof, sentences 'The composition, refinement, exchange and proper-coincidence identities are [prop-sf-pf-coherence]' and 'Every step constructs or compares the same projection map'. The strict-system equality stated here is an additional agent-formulated obligation, made explicit in the existing DAG proof of fix-prop-projection-formula, Step 11; the blueprint paragraph itself does not state it.

proof.text: The joint naturality clause is elementary from the specified compactification word: apply naturality of the uncurried properProjection transformation, naturality of OpenComparisons.projection, and naturality of the inverse pullback compositor followed by the compactification equation cast. Combine the three squares using functoriality of tensor, open extension and proper direct image. This part works for all systems and uses none of the finite-Tor domain assumptions. The following steps record the composition assembly and the finite-evaluation argument for the specified word.

source.place: Final paragraph: the projection transformations are natural with the displayed sources and targets; direct naturality of the specified compactification word.

proof.text: Prove the reverse refinement is invertible from [lem-sf-system-proper-open-support]; its other factors are isomorphisms. Therefore change, triangleWord and compositor are invertible on all systems. Naturality of change follows from the two refinement natural transformations and their inverses.

Apply [lem-pur-system-projection-change-compatibility] to each of the three chosen compactifications and the corresponding canonical triangle compactification. Move the first input transport through the projection for g by joint naturality. Move the g-transport and final output transport by naturality of change. Apply [lem-pur-system-projection-triangle-compatibility] to the remaining triangle word. Paste the three change squares and combine tensor maps by functoriality. The resulting equation is exactly leftMap = rightMap in systems.
Apply coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation at each n, and coefficientSequenceLimit, to the already established system equality, using congrArg of their map functions.

Eliminate the compactification factorization equality so its composite is definitionally the original morphism. Evaluate the proper projection by the normalized adjunction transpose formula, using the recorded unit/counit equations and pullbackTensorSystemComparison_evaluation. Evaluate the inverse open tensor transpose by the open-evaluation mate equation; invertibility transports its forward comparison. Naturality of the evaluation tensor comparison and systemPullbackCompositorEvaluation identify the final inverse pullback compositor and its equality cast. Paste the proper square, the open square with its second endpoint changed by the evaluated proper pullback, and this last tensor square. This gives exactly projection_evaluation for the specified finite word, on all system inputs.

Re-split rule: each old step goes to a new node or to an existing node whose statement covers it. Old 1 -> ringed-sequence-site, semilinear-derived-sections and sfb-ringed-projection-tensor-composition. Old 2 -> sfb-ringed-projection-tensor-composition, whose π_gf=R_g(π_f)π_g equation is exactly old step 2. Old 3-4 -> N1 plus semilinear-proper-open-mate-pasting. Old 5 -> N2. Old 7 -> N3 plus pf-substitution. Old 8-9 -> steps 5-7. Nothing was blurred. Step 3's 'same intrinsic mate' holds because the pasting node states that its unit-alpha-counit mate is the J_i-adjunct of lambda^{-1}, which is integral-compactification-system-realization's Γ_Q. N1 (invertibility of the general clopen mate): true by proper base change at each level plus joint evaluation detecting isomorphisms. Tested on an identity square, A empty, and a refinement square with an extra component. Its definition repeats the pasting node and pf-substitution already covers r=1 squares, but invertibility for general squares is new (advisory). N2: β=R_sp(e)·d·R_s(γJ_j) is well typed for the square (b1,i,q,p1) and is 1 for f=g=id. Same-day Q132 lem-sf-projection-compatible-triangle-assembly states only the finite-level identification, so N2 is not a duplicate. N3: both sides of the equation are typed; the induced refinements check (v b1 j1=b2 j2, s2 p2 v=s1 p1, u, v, w proper); a common dominating Cartesian triangle exists via V=X̄×_Ȳ Y; identity refinements give β1=β2.
